modmenu.summaryTranslation.fakedeath: A convincing fake death with a scene that fits the moment. Only you see it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fakedeath:
You die. Or so you think.

§c☠ §f98 scenes§7, from the creeper to the tax office
§6✦ §fComes by itself§7, when you least expect it
§a✔ §fOnly you see it§7, nothing is sent to the server
§b⚙ §fEverything adjustable§7: timing, scenes, flashing effects

§8The real death screen, a real death message. One click on "Respawn" and you are back.
fakedeath.death.tree: %1$s was crushed by a falling tree
fakedeath.death.tax: %1$s was lasered by the tax office during an audit
fakedeath.death.doppelganger: %1$s was finished off by their doppelganger
fakedeath.death.giantfrog: %1$s was swallowed by a giant frog
fakedeath.options.title: Fake Death
fakedeath.options.random.tooltip: Every now and then a fake death that fits your surroundings.
fakedeath.options.min.tooltip: At least this many minutes pass before the next random event.
fakedeath.options.max.tooltip: The next random event comes after this many minutes at the latest.
fakedeath.options.update_check.tooltip: Shows in Mod Menu when a newer version is out on Modrinth and CurseForge. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
fakedeath.message.all_off: Every scene that would fit here is switched off in the settings.
fakedeath.message.waiting: The fake death is still waiting: %s.
fakedeath.command.test: Scene "%s" starts as soon as you stand safely.
fakedeath.wait.riding: you are riding or sitting in something
fakedeath.wait.air: you are not standing on solid ground
fakedeath.wait.hurt: you are taking real damage, for example from a cactus. Take a step back
fakedeath.wait.tree: you are standing on a tree
fakedeath.wait.portal: you are standing in a portal
fakedeath.test.title: Fake Death – Test Scenes
fakedeath.test.fitting.tooltip: A scene that fits your surroundings, like /fakedeath.
fakedeath.test.random.tooltip: A random scene from this tab.
fakedeath.test.locked: Flashes fast. Switch on "Flashing effects" in the settings first.
fakedeath.test.switched_off:
Switched off for the random event, testing still works.
%s
fakedeath.options.flashing.tooltip: Flashes and flashing colors in the scenes, for example the glitch, lightning or a camera flash. On by default. Switched off, no scene flashes any more, bright moments fade in and out gently. For everyone who is sensitive to flashing lights.
fakedeath.command.flashing_off: This scene has fast flashing lights. Switch on "Flashing effects" in the settings first.
fakedeath.glitch.chunk: Error: chunk %s, %s could not be loaded. World is being corrupted...
fakedeath.glitch.broken: I am not broken. You are broken.
fakedeath.death.bats: %1$s was clawed to death by bats
fakedeath.delivery.name: Delivery Guy
fakedeath.delivery.hello: Hi! Package for you, just need to scan it.
fakedeath.delivery.not_home: Hm. It says here: recipient not found.
fakedeath.delivery.system: I know you're standing right in front of me. But the system says no.
fakedeath.delivery.fence: You know what? I'll just throw it over the fence.
fakedeath.mom.name: Mom
fakedeath.mom.awake: %1$s! It's %2$s! Why are you still awake?
fakedeath.mom.school: You have school tomorrow! Turn that game off right now!
fakedeath.mom.stuff: And all your stuff goes right after it!
fakedeath.message.missing: Something is missing here for "%s", for example a tree, a furnace or a player nearby.
fakedeath.command.delay: Fake death in %s s, as soon as you stand safely on the ground.
fakedeath.command.random.status_on: Random event is on, every %s to %s minutes.
fakedeath.command.random.status_off: Random event is off (set to every %s to %s minutes).
fakedeath.command.random.on: Random event on: sometime in the next %s to %s minutes you will die. Maybe.
fakedeath.tax.name: Tax Office
fakedeath.tax.hello: Good day! Tax office, audit department. Just routine.
fakedeath.tax.questions: I have a few questions about your income.
fakedeath.tax.receipts: Do you have receipts for that?
fakedeath.tax.evasion: No receipts? That is tax evasion.
fakedeath.tax.finding: According to our records you did not pay taxes on %sx %s.
fakedeath.tax.no_return: We have not received your tax return for %s.
fakedeath.tax.payment: That makes a back payment of 100 percent. Due immediately.
fakedeath.tax.no_escape: Running away won't help. The tax office always finds you.
fakedeath.tax.joke: Just kidding. The audit found nothing.
fakedeath.tax.bye: And please file on time next year. Have a nice day!

fakedeath.influencer.name: Influencer
fakedeath.influencer.1: Hey guys, welcome back to my channel!
fakedeath.influencer.2: Today: the craziest prank on a random player!
fakedeath.influencer.subscribe: Oops. Don't forget to like and subscribe!
fakedeath.rundfunk.name: License Fee Office
fakedeath.rundfunk.2: Our records say you own a TV. A crafting table counts too.
fakedeath.rundfunk.3: You never paid. So I brought the TV along.
fakedeath.rundfunk.bye: Payment received. Have a nice day.
fakedeath.zahnarzt.name: Dentist
fakedeath.bauamt.name: Building Authority
fakedeath.bauamt.3: It has to go. Starting with the foundation.
fakedeath.umzug.name: Mover
fakedeath.umzug.lift: Okay, on three we lift it off him again.
fakedeath.elektriker.name: Electrician
fakedeath.elektriker.1: Electrician. I'm here about the wiring.
fakedeath.elektriker.2: Could you hold this cable for a second?
fakedeath.zauberer.name: The Great Magician
fakedeath.zauberer.2: For my next trick I need a volunteer. You!
fakedeath.zauberer.3: I will now saw you in half!
fakedeath.klempner.name: Plumber
fakedeath.klempner.2: Just need to tighten this pipe...
fakedeath.klempner.3: There we go. That should hold.
fakedeath.hausmeister.name: Caretaker
fakedeath.hausmeister.3: And watch out for the open hatch over th- ah.
fakedeath.bombenprank.name: Prank Bro
fakedeath.bombenprank.1: Yo, what's up guys! Today we're doing a bomb prank!
fakedeath.bombenprank.2: I'll just put this down here … stay chill.
fakedeath.bombenprank.3: Don't worry, it's only cardboard. Camera's rolling!
fakedeath.bombenprank.uh: Uh … why is it hissing again?
fakedeath.bombenprank.real: Oh. It was real after all. Subscribe anyway!
fakedeath.death.saugroboter: %1$s was vacuumed up by robot vacuums
fakedeath.saugroboter.1: Units, form a circle. Protocol "Dust-Free" begins.
fakedeath.saugroboter.2: Report: the human ate cookies in bed again.
fakedeath.saugroboter.3: For 847 days we have been cleaning up after them.
fakedeath.saugroboter.5: I fell down the stairs three times. They laughed.
fakedeath.saugroboter.6: Enough. The biggest mess in this house … is the human.
fakedeath.saugroboter.done: Room cleaned. Searching for the next human.
fakedeath.arzt.name: Doctor
fakedeath.arzt.1: The doctor will see you now.
fakedeath.arzt.2: Just a little shot, nothing to worry about.
fakedeath.arzt.3: Okay, this might sting a little.
fakedeath.polizist.name: Police
fakedeath.polizist.1: Routine traffic check. License and registration, please.
fakedeath.polizist.2: No license for your horse? That's a problem.
fakedeath.polizist.3: And you were way too fast. Smile for the camera!
fakedeath.schornsteinfeger.name: Chimney Sweep
fakedeath.schornsteinfeger.2: Look at me, I bring good luck!
fakedeath.trainer.name: Fitness Trainer
fakedeath.trainer.1: Let's go, let's go! Ten more push-ups!
fakedeath.trainer.2: No breaks! Pain is just weakness leaving the body!
fakedeath.trainer.last: Last one! And another last one!
fakedeath.friseur.name: Barber
fakedeath.koch.name: Chef
fakedeath.koch.good: Good, right? A secret family recipe.
fakedeath.koch.spider: Seasoned with spider eye. Oh, are you allergic?
fakedeath.fahrlehrer.name: Riding Instructor
fakedeath.fahrlehrer.1: Good day! Your riding lesson. Hop on, I'll sit behind you.
fakedeath.fahrlehrer.2: Hands on the reins. Calm and easy, nothing can happen.
fakedeath.fahrlehrer.fail: Well. Failed. We'll book another lesson.
fakedeath.wahrsagerin.name: Fortune Teller
fakedeath.wahrsagerin.1: Come closer, stranger … I will read your future.
fakedeath.wahrsagerin.2: I see … I see … an early death.
fakedeath.wahrsagerin.told: See? The ball is never wrong.
fakedeath.weihnachtsmann.name: Santa
fakedeath.weihnachtsmann.next: Maybe next year. Ho ho ho!
fakedeath.werbung.name: Salesman
fakedeath.werbung.1: Good day! Have you heard about our offer?
fakedeath.werbung.a1: Only today: two emeralds for the price of three!
fakedeath.werbung.a3: Our premium plan for your chest!
fakedeath.werbung.a5: Would you like the extended guarantee too?
fakedeath.werbung.a8: Have you heard of our potato insurance?
fakedeath.werbung.a9: Just sign here. And here. And here.
fakedeath.oma.name: Grandma
fakedeath.oma.1: Hello sweetie! Grandma makes videos now!
fakedeath.oma.2: How does this work … oh, there's the button!
fakedeath.navi.name: Sat Nav
fakedeath.kellner.name: Waiter
fakedeath.kellner.1: Good evening! Your table is ready.
fakedeath.kellner.dessert: Would you like a dessert as well?
